# ServiceHub

> Self-hosted, open-source forensic debugger for cloud messaging. Investigate dead-letter queues,
> inspect and search message content, recover failed messages, and prove what happened with
> tamper-evident recovery evidence. Azure Service Bus is GA; AWS SQS/SNS and GCP Pub/Sub are
> Supported — conformance-tested against live infrastructure, with each provider's real
> limitations published rather than papered over.

ServiceHub is single-instance, self-hosted software for one team — not a multi-tenant SaaS. It is
read-only by default (peek, never consume), encrypts connection strings at rest, and runs its
primary AI-assisted analysis entirely client-side in the browser with no message data sent to any
third-party or cloud AI service. Recovery actions are gated by per-identity governance roles and a
deterministic eligibility gate, and every recovery is recorded in a hash-chained evidence ledger
that an auditor can verify offline with a standalone script.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/README.md): What ServiceHub is, feature tour, quick start, security model, FAQ
- [Complete Service Guide](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/SERVICEHUB-COMPLETE-GUIDE.md): Screen-by-screen reference for every page, concept, and workflow
- [Recovery Evidence Ledger](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/RECOVERY-EVIDENCE.md): The hash-chained recovery evidence model introduced in v3.7.0
- [Provider Conformance](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/PROVIDER-CONFORMANCE.md): What each provider can and cannot prove, and the live evidence behind the Supported labels
- [Architecture](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): System design, provider abstraction, and the AI capability boundary
- [Self-hosting](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/self-hosting/README.md): Deployment, persistent storage, least-privilege cloud credentials, single-instance constraints
- [Backup and restore](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/BACKUP-RESTORE.md): Atomic SQLite backup, restore, and verification procedure
- [Architecture Decision Records](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/adr/README.md): Why the product is shaped the way it is, including the single-instance SQLite decision
- [Adding a provider](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/docs/extending/adding-a-provider.md): How the Azure/AWS/GCP provider abstraction extends to new backends
- [Changelog](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history, including what shipped in v4.0.0
- [Releases](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/releases): Version history and release notes
- [License](https://github.com/debdevops/servicehub/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
